subject: Pilot results + renewal options for Astra Tech
messages:
From: Jared Collins <jared.collins@astra-tech.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 17 Jun 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot results and next steps

Hi Sean / Monica,

Thanks again for standing up the dedicated pool for our 6-week pilot. The team ran our full inference workload against the beta model and I attached the short pilot report (astra-pilot-report.pdf) with numbers, latency percentiles, and token consumption by endpoint. Two quick highlights:

- Avg latency improved 28% versus our current infra for the chat path; p95 is still slightly above our internal SLO by ~120ms (we show traces).
- Token mix shifted heavily toward embedding/replicate calls during batch indexing, which drove a 34% increase in token spend relative to our estimate.

Overall the business leads are happy with output quality and latency trend, but procurement needs a clear renewal/commit proposal that addresses token mix variability and operational guardrails (burst credits, autoscaling). Can you share proposed term options, a short mutual action plan, and a draft quote? Procurement also asked for SOC2 evidence and DocuSign-ready terms.

Attaching: astra-pilot-report.pdf

Thanks,
Jared
Jared Collins
Director, AI Platforms | Astra Tech
jared.collins@astra-tech.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Jared Collins <jared.collins@astra-tech.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 17 Jun 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot results and next steps

Hi Jared — great write-up, appreciate the detail. Saw the p95 traces; we can tighten that down with a config tweak and smarter prefix caching for your chat endpoints.

Attached is a short proposal worksheet (redwood-proposal-ASTRA-2028.xlsx) with three options:
1) 12-month commit (baseline) with 10% unit discount + 25% burst credits to cover indexing spikes
2) 9-month bridge + 6-month evaluation with higher per-token rate but lower committed minimum (for seasonal workloads)
3) 24-month preferred rate with a performance SLA and shared savings on quantization-driven cost reductions

My suggested starting point: the 12-month commit (option 1) with a 15% one-time onboarding credit to offset initial token variance. If procurement needs a shorter legal term, option 2 is easy to convert into a staged addendum.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll send DOCS/terms + SOC2 attestation to procurement this afternoon
- Monica will coordinate a short tech workshop with your infra leads to land the p95 improvements
- Karthik, can you prepare final pricing and the DocuSign-ready quote by EOD tomorrow?

If that sounds good I’ll lock the MA POC/commit in our pipeline and circulate a mutual action plan.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0890

From: Jared Collins <jared.collins@astra-tech.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@astra-tech.com
Date: Sun, 17 Jun 2028 11:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot results and next steps

Sean — thanks. Procurement looped in and they want:
- A DocuSign-ready order form and the redlined T&Cs (we’ll mark a couple of commercial redlines)
- SOC2 type II report and the last 12 months of security questionnaire answers
- A clear statement of expected monthly token run-rate under option 1 and a mechanism for reconciling overages (preferably cap + true-up).

On the terms, our legal team is ok with 12 months but wants the onboarding credit to be applied as a one-time invoice credit rather than a rate adjustment. Also, can you confirm the SLA target for p95? I’ll push for the SLA in the PO but wanted to confirm we can meet it with the caching plan.

I’ll also set a tentative procurement deadline of Jun 30 so we can start FY Q4 provisioning.

—Jared

Attachments referenced: astra-pilot-report.pdf

From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 17 Jun 2028 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Astra next steps + MAP (mutual action plan)

Folks — quick summary and proposed MAP to get this to signature by Jun 30: 

1) Pricing & PO artifacts (Karthik) — finalize option 1 quote, produce DocuSign order form, and include one-time onboarding credit line item. Target: EOD tomorrow (2028-06-18 17:00 PT).
2) Security & compliance (Sean) — send SOC2 Type II report and the last security questionnaire export to procurement (procurement@astra-tech.com). Target: today.
3) Performance workstream (Monica) — schedule a 60-min tech workshop to implement prefix caching and tweak batch size; expected p95 improvement target: -120ms. Target: schedule this week.
4) Commercial guardrails — include 25% burst buffer for indexing spikes and a monthly true-up process; propose cap of 40% over committed run-rate before auto-escalation to dedicated pool.

Additional ask: commercial would like a 10% discount on list price for the first 3 billing cycles post-signature as a goodwill for pilot support. Recommend we approve this as a short-term concession and offset via onboarding credit structure.

I’ll draft the mutual action plan doc and share a Drive link to the consolidated artifacts. Also opening a small internal ticket to capture the SLA language for Karthik/legal.

—Monica
